relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Headache attack frequency reduced from 20.56 to 7.44 and 6.37 headache days per month after the third and the sixth administration of monthly galcanezumab 120 mg s.c., respectively (p < 0.001).

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: A significant reduction in PCS scores, in all sub-domains, was found since the third monthly galcanezumab administration.

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The “whole total pain burden” score decreased from baseline 1975.05 to 477.05 and 383.72 after the third and the sixth administration of monthly galcanezumab 120 mg s.c., respectively (p < 0.001)

key_findings: In 43 migraine patients with multiple failed preventives, monthly galcanezumab 120 mg reduced headache days from 20.56 to 6.37 over 6 months.
Galcanezumab also improved disability, depression, anxiety and pain catastrophizing; a composite whole pain burden score fell significantly.
